_intent: PP-T03 driver — bootstrap leaf with red test_gate referenced by later build-time edge; also triggers INV-12 permission_red_tests_write (F3 audit: bootstrap leaf declares a write to red_tests/, which the dry-run rejects).
name: bootstrap-red
description: Single bootstrap node 'preflight' exposes outputs.tool_path + test_gate(tool_id, oracle[], allow_non_deterministic=false, timeout_sec, cost_ceiling) + 11-field provenance. oracles all pass:false → test_gate evaluates to 'red'. The followup leaf 'use_probe' depends_on preflight and lists preflight's tool_id in toolRefs, so the build-time edge references a non-green tool → PP-T03 tool_not_green. The bootstrap node additionally declares write_set=['red_tests/bootstrap_probe.py'] to drive the F3 audit (bootstrap leaf 写 red_tests/ 被拒). Followup node stays strictly within natural_pool (built-in read) so no PP-T01/T02 fires. No skills attached → no PP-S01/S02/S03. oracleKind, whyNoFanout, budgetBasis populated on the followup leaf.

use_probe.goal: consume the probe bootstrap's tool_path downstream of preflight
use_probe.whyNoFanout: single terminal consumer of the preflight bootstrap — no peer to parallelize with
